sal.basis: Qatar pay is quoted monthly, tax-free, as a total package (basic + housing + transport; Qataris in government and semi-government grades also get a social allowance). Senior Financial Analyst / Senior FP&A, ~8 yrs, Doha: roughly QAR 22-32k a month for expats at large employers and QAR 35-50k for Qatari nationals at banks and state companies (recalled from regional salary guides; web research was unavailable for this run, so not re-verified). Maryam is Qatari, so the band leans to the top of the expat range / bottom of the national range. f = 0.9 maps the v5 Riyadh band 34-41k SAR to QAR 30.6-36.9k, so Maryam earns ~QAR 23,400 and expects ~30,600. QAR and SAR are near par (both USD-pegged, 1 SAR = 0.971 QAR). Plausible range for f: 0.8-1.05.

rule.en: We skip Qatari-only roles unless you are Qatari. If your visa is through an employer or you need one, we also skip roles that ask for a family-sponsored visa.
rule.ar: نتخطّى الوظائف المخصّصة للقطريين إلا إذا كانت جنسيتك قطرية. وإذا إقامتك عن طريق جهة عمل أو تحتاج تأشيرة، نتخطّى بعد الوظائف اللي تطلب إقامة على كفالة العائلة.
rule.fr: Nous écartons les postes réservés aux Qatariens si vous n'avez pas cette nationalité. Si votre visa dépend d'un employeur ou si vous avez besoin d'un visa, nous écartons aussi les offres qui exigent une résidence parrainée par la famille.

desc.en: Qatari nationals, then children of Qatari mothers, get priority in hiring, and a 2024 law lets the Ministry of Labour set Qatari targets for private-sector jobs. We only apply to roles marked Qatari nationals only if you are Qatari.
desc.ar: الأولوية في التوظيف للقطريين ثم أبناء القطريات، وقانون توطين الوظائف في القطاع الخاص (2024) يخلّي وزارة العمل تحدد نسب القطريين في الوظائف. وما نقدّم على الوظائف المخصصة للقطريين إلا إذا كانت جنسيتك قطرية.
desc.fr: Les ressortissants qatariens, puis les enfants de mère qatarienne, sont prioritaires à l'embauche, et une loi de 2024 permet au ministère du Travail de fixer des objectifs de Qatariens dans les emplois du secteur privé. Nous ne postulons aux offres réservées aux ressortissants qatariens que si vous avez la nationalité qatarienne.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on Qatari CVs and on regional boards (Bayt, GulfTalent), but not needed for ATS uploads; we offer it and never require it. Gender, date of birth and nationality are standard fields on Qatari application forms (state companies, the national airline, HMC, banks) and on Bayt/GulfTalent profiles; nationality also drives Qatarization and visa handling, and recruiters expect QID or visa status on the CV. Marital status often appears on Gulf CVs (and family sponsorship matters for some expat applicants) but it is not needed for matching, so we do not ask (conservative, PDPPL data minimisation). Qatar's Constitution (Art. 35) bars discrimination on sex, origin, language or religion and the Labour Law requires equal pay for women, but there is no detailed private-hiring anti-discrimination code, so we set our own rule: never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Qatari-only postings.

legal.law: Qatar PDPPL (Law No. 13 of 2016 on Personal Data Privacy Protection); the QFC Data Protection Regulations 2021 apply in the Qatar Financial Centre

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Doha. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I present our results to the board in Arabic and English. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Doha, Lusail, or remote.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في الدوحة. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات التي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث، وأعرض نتائجنا على مجلس الإدارة بالعربية والإنجليزية. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في الدوحة أو لوسيل أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financière avec 8 ans d'expérience à Doha. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre délai de reporting, et je présente nos résultats au conseil d'administration en arabe et en anglais. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financière senior ou en FP&A à Doha, à Lusail ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Sun-Thu (Friday-Saturday weekend); government works roughly 7:00-14:00 and some private firms add a Saturday half-day, so interviews and deadlines in copy should use Sun-Thu days. Salaries are quoted monthly, tax-free, as a package (basic + housing + transport; Qataris in government and semi-government grades also get a social allowance) and paid monthly through the Wage Protection System (WPS). Notice under Labour Law 14/2004 as amended by Law 18/2020: 1 month if service is 2 years or less, 2 months if more, both for resigning to change jobs and for employer termination; senior contracts may state longer. Since 2020 expats no longer need an NOC or exit permit to change jobs or leave the country. Qataris in government follow the Civil HR Law instead. CVs: 2 pages, English (an Arabic version helps for government and semi-government roles), with a personal block (nationality, QID or visa status, often date of birth and photo). Cover letters are rarely required; portals ask screening questions instead. Arabic is valued and often required for Qatari-only and government-facing roles; English is the working language in business. During Ramadan, working hours are capped at 36 a week (6 a day). Many bank, energy and semi-government finance roles are Qatari-only or Qatari-preferred. Recruiters and hiring managers are a mix of Qataris and expats (Arab, South Asian, Filipino, Western).
